every mention of identity/trust level must fall inside one of five listed denial phrasings, so 'It does not depend on your identity or trust level.' fails as 'no longer says it is not about identity' -- a false fail that would open and file a new row.
judged_theirs accepts any non-meta result whatever its outcome, so a full run where every vendor check was inconclusive (an outage) still reads as the last full run.

the same defect as B08, found independently: denials recognises a fixed list of phrasings, so 'unrelated to your identity' fails as not denying it.

says_wording is a substring test ('wording' in hint), so 'It is not about the wording' passes as 'its hint says it is about the wording' -- the presence-vs-value shape the docstring fixed for the identity half.

any accepted newest buy on the struck card counts as the fix, with no check of its amount against the balance the refusal quoted nor that it was paper: a 5 USDC buy the wrong 7.65 balance also covers passes while a 480 USDC paper buy would still get the 409.

asks_retry reads any 'try again' as asking to retry the SAME request, so a fixed refusal ('You already hold a paper clone of this bot. Try again with a different bot.') fails as the defect -- a false fail (B02 is the other direction of the same predicate).
